annotations.title: Check VAT registration and the Flat Rate Scheme

description: Check whether a turnover is over the UK VAT registration threshold for a tax year, and compare VAT payable under the standard scheme with the Flat Rate Scheme for the business's sector rate, including the first-year discount, with the cheaper scheme and the difference.

flatRatePercent.description: Flat Rate Scheme percentage for the sector, e.g. 14.5 for IT consultancy

taxYear.description: UK tax year, e.g. "2026-27". Defaults to the current one.
